mapper.select: SELECT s.seat_code, s.seat_type, s.seat_real_num, s.sale, s.screening_num FROM T_Seat s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r1.* FROM T_SeatReservation r1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT seat_code, schedule_num, MAX(reserved_at) AS latest_time FROM T_SeatReservation GROUP BY seat_code, schedule_num ) r2 ON r1.seat_code = r2.seat_code AND r1.schedule_num = r2.schedule_num AND r1.reserved_at = r2.latest_time ) r ON s.seat_code = r.seat_code AND r.schedule_num = #{scheduleNum} WHERE s.screening_num = ( SELECT screening_num FROM T_Schedule WHERE schedule_num = #{scheduleNum} ) AND (r.reserved IS NULL OR r.reserved = 0)
SELECT r.*, s.seat_real_num, s.seat_type, s.sale, s.screening_num FROM T_SeatReservation r JOIN T_Seat s ON r.seat_code = s.seat_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_SeatReservation ( reservation_id, schedule_num, seat_code, reserved, reserved_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationId}, #{scheduleNum}, #{seatCode}, #{reserved}, #{reservedAt} )
